title: Anne S NDE 696
content:
An inner body separated from my outer body after clasp mechanism had released it. I floated to corner of ceiling, passed through the roof, saw layers in roof as at the atomic level or cellular level. I drifted upwards into the night sky, saw rooftops, houses, streets, gardens, parked cars from above, I saw starts in night sky, then entered a yellow light tunnel. The tunnel had ring structure; my hand would not pass through its wall. I traveled down the center of the tunnel until I touched the wall at high speed; this made me crash into the walls for a while, then I regained equilibrium. I heard a voice saying I mustn't worry, 'Dying is easy, you're nearly there,' etc. The tunnel opened out like the end of a trumpet into a space that had rainbow colors and a sky. I was drawn to the left and went along a path of reddish golden soil/clay, but gliding without using my legs. I saw plants, bushes, and a golden sunlight type of light. I approached a group of non-material people clothed in long cotton type clothes tied at the waist. I thought I vaguely saw my mother and father in the group of about ten people. The leader at the front made me understand the space between us was a boundary and if I crossed over it, I couldn't come back to Earth as I was before. I was absorbed into his eyes and he showed me his world, flying over hills, waterfalls, and scenery in golden light. He said that if I wanted to go with him, all I had to do was to touch his hand, which he raised towards me. I said I wasn't ready yet, and he raised his hand and propelled me backwards down the light tunnel, back through the ceiling of the doctor's surgery. I hovered horizontally and then was lowered nearer to my body, there was some adjustment of limbs to align the two bodies, and then I dropped back in on the doctor's couch. The doctors came in and injected the back of my hand (vein) with what I think was adrenaline, but I'm not sure what it was.

arrival.other_being_detail: A group of about ten 'non-material people' in long cotton-type clothes tied at the waist, with a 'leader' at the front.

environment.environment_other_detail: Tunnel opened like end of a trumpet into a space with rainbow colors and a sky; path of reddish golden soil/clay; plants and bushes; golden sunlight-type light; later shown hills, waterfalls, scenery in golden light.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived roof layers at 'atomic level or cellular level'; tunnel had ring structure and was physically resistant to the hand; shown another world by being 'absorbed into his eyes.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (ceiling/roof/night sky) → yellow light tunnel → opens into colorful sky/landscape/path → group of non-material people/leader → boundary explained → choice offered (touch hand) → return propelled back through tunnel → re-entry/alignment with body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Tunnel described as yellow with a ring structure; hand could not pass through the tunnel wall; collision with tunnel walls until equilibrium regained; seeing roof layers at 'atomic level or cellular level'; vision of leader's world by being 'absorbed into his eyes'; re-entry included 'adjustment of limbs to align the two bodies.'
